entries.summary: Severe factual hallucination and thin world knowledge — SimpleQA 6.7 and 53.2% PersonQA hallucination are OpenAI's own figures, and community testing found it 'unbelievably ignorant' offline.

mitigations.note: Give it web search — it was explicitly designed to look things up rather than know them, and its tool use is good enough to make this work.
Grounded document Q&A sidesteps the recall gap entirely.
